- When clicking to skip opening, after a few minutes in the home menu, the screen would go dark for a few seconds. When he found out about the problem, FIL was in a race and soon after finishing it, he also fixed this problem. (Current situation - Corrected)
- New problems, please message FIL the squirrel, he will quickly fix it.
Thank you and good fun everyone!!
